programs.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
programs.desc: Jedi younglings Kai, Lys, and Nubs train together on the planet Tenoo, blasting off on adventures throughout the galaxy with ace pilot Nash in the Crimson Firehawk!

programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: Thomas, Percy, and Nia have to make a delivery deep into the mainland but that means spending the night in a new shed along the way. But it's dark and there are so many scary sounds that Percy does not find it at all comforting like sleeping in Tidmouth Shed. With Thomas and Nia's help, Percy might be able to change his view and feel right at home.

programs.title: Octonauts: Above And Beyond
programs.desc: When unseasonably warm temperatures wake a family of hibernating dormice, Paani, Tweak, and Shellington try to protect the sleepwalking mice from lurking predators.

programs.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programs.desc: King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming and is preparing to welcome him in style. King Thistle is feeling left out. He is a king too!

programs.title: Teletubbies
programs.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po do a roundy round dance and watch children in Tummy Tales ride a carousel which goes round and round too.
